Q8553.reason: Alcoholic chronic pancreatitis causes fat malabsorption (steatorrhea), so fat-soluble vitamin D is lost and hypocalcemia produces tetany (Chvostek/Trousseau, perioral paresthesias); osteomalacia is the bone consequence, not the acute diagnosis.

Q8555.reason: Fever, pharyngitis, and conjunctivitis in a summer-camp swimming-pool outbreak is pharyngoconjunctival fever, classically caused by adenovirus.
